name: Bathroom Design Studio
intro: Design your new bathroom in 10 simple steps. Choose your layout, style, finishes and fittings, then send your design to us for a free, no-obligation quotation.
imageCredit: Images illustrate design options and are not photographs of MM Projects' own work.

shots.style: Photorealistic interior photograph of a premium UK home bathroom. Soft natural daylight, warm neutral palette, eye-level camera, sharp focus, high-end interior design magazine quality. No people, no text, no logos, no brand names. Portrait 2:3.

bases.room: A medium-sized modern UK family bathroom (about 2.4 m by 2.2 m) seen from the doorway: large light grey stone-effect porcelain tiles, a walk-in shower with a frameless glass screen on the left, a floating light oak wall-hung vanity with a white basin in the centre, a round mirror above, a wall-hung toilet on the right, chrome fittings, a frosted window. Clean, calm, uncluttered.
bases.wall: Close-up of a bathroom shower wall, straight on, filling the frame: tiles from floor to ceiling, a recessed shower niche at chest height with two neutral toiletry bottles, a slim chrome shower valve at the bottom right. Soft daylight from the left.
bases.floor: Close-up of a bathroom floor seen from above at a gentle angle, filling the frame, with the bottom of a light oak wall-hung vanity and a white bath mat at the top edge. Soft daylight.
bases.vanity: Close-up of the vanity area, straight on: a wall-hung vanity unit with two drawers below a white basin, a tap, a round mirror above, light grey stone-effect wall tiles behind. Soft daylight.
bases.tap: Close-up of a modern single-lever basin tap on a white countertop basin, a light oak vanity top and light grey stone-effect tiles softly blurred behind. Soft daylight, crisp reflections on the metal.

steps.title: What kind of bathroom?
steps.intro: Start with the room you're planning.

options.label: Full bathroom
options.prompt: A spacious main family bathroom with a bath, a separate walk-in shower, a vanity and a toilet.

options.label: En suite
options.prompt: A compact en suite bathroom seen through an open door from a bedroom, with a walk-in shower, a small vanity and a toilet.

options.label: Cloakroom
options.prompt: A small downstairs cloakroom with a wall-hung toilet and a compact corner basin, with a feature tiled wall.

options.label: Bathroom refresh
options.prompt: An existing bathroom being refreshed: new vanity, new mirror and freshly tiled splashback, bath kept in place, bright and tidy.

steps.title: Your layout
steps.intro: Moving the toilet, bath or shower is usually the biggest part of the cost, so it helps to know early.

options.label: Keep the existing layout
options.prompt: Show this bathroom as an architect's top-down floor plan drawing in soft grey lines on white paper, with the shower, vanity and toilet in their current places and a small 'same layout' tick in sage green. No text other than room labels.

options.label: Change the layout
options.desc: Move the bath, shower or toilet
options.prompt: Show this bathroom as an architect's top-down floor plan drawing in soft grey lines on white paper, with dashed arrows showing the shower and vanity swapping places. No text other than room labels.

options.label: Not sure yet
options.prompt: A designer's desk with a sketched bathroom floor plan, tile samples, a tape measure and a pencil, top-down view, soft daylight.

steps.title: Bath and shower
steps.intro: Choose what you'd like to wash in.

options.label: Walk-in shower
options.desc: Open, level and easy to clean
options.prompt: Use the base bathroom exactly as described.

options.label: Shower enclosure
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Replace only the walk-in shower with a square shower enclosure with a hinged glass door and a low shower tray.

options.label: Bath only
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Replace only the walk-in shower with a white built-in bath with a tiled bath panel, no shower.

options.label: Shower over bath
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Replace only the walk-in shower with a white built-in bath with a fixed glass bath screen and an overhead rainfall shower above it.

options.label: Separate bath and shower
options.prompt: Keep everything identical but show a slightly wider room: a freestanding white bath on the right and the walk-in shower on the left.

steps.title: Your style
steps.intro: Pick the look that feels most like you.

options.label: Modern
options.prompt: Keep the same room shape and camera. Restyle as a crisp modern bathroom: large matt white and grey tiles, handleless white vanity, matt black fittings.

options.label: Traditional
options.prompt: Keep the same room shape and camera. Restyle as a traditional bathroom: white metro tiles, wood panelling painted soft grey, a freestanding roll-top bath, a period basin on legs, chrome cross-head taps.

options.label: Contemporary luxury
options.prompt: Keep the same room shape and camera. Restyle as a contemporary luxury bathroom: large marble-effect tiles, dark walnut vanity, brushed brass fittings, warm LED strip lighting in the niche and under the vanity.

options.label: Minimalist
options.prompt: Keep the same room shape and camera. Restyle as a minimalist bathroom: warm white microcement-look walls, a simple floating vanity, hidden storage, almost no visible accessories.

options.label: Not sure yet
options.prompt: A bathroom mood board on a light wooden table: tile samples in grey, white and sage, a brass tap sample, a small oak offcut and a sketch, top-down, soft daylight.

steps.title: Wall finishes
steps.intro: Choose how the walls are finished, then the tile style and colour.

options.label: Fully tiled
options.prompt: Use the base bathroom exactly as described.

options.label: Half tiled
options.desc: Tiles to about waist height, paint above
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Tile only up to about 1.2 m on the walls outside the shower, with soft warm white paint above.

options.label: Wet wall panels
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Replace the tiles in the shower and behind the vanity with large seamless grey stone-effect waterproof wall panels with no grout lines and thin aluminium trims.

options.label: Painted walls
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Tile only inside the shower; paint all other walls soft warm white.

options.label: Large format
options.prompt: Use the base wall with large 60 by 120 cm light grey stone-effect porcelain tiles.

options.label: Metro
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tiles to white gloss metro tiles in a brick bond with thin grey grout.

options.label: Marble effect
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tiles to large white marble-effect porcelain tiles with soft grey veining.

options.label: Stone effect
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tiles to warm beige textured stone-effect tiles.

options.label: Terrazzo
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tiles to light terrazzo tiles with small grey and terracotta chips.

options.label: Zellige
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tiles to small handmade glossy zellige-style tiles in soft sage green with slightly uneven surfaces.

options.label: Patterned
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tiles to grey and white geometric patterned tiles.

options.label: White
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tile colour to bright white.

options.label: Light grey
options.prompt: Use the base wall (light grey).

options.label: Charcoal
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tile colour to deep charcoal grey.

options.label: Warm stone
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tile colour to warm beige stone.

options.label: Sage green
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tile colour to soft sage green.

options.label: Soft blue
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tile colour to muted dusty blue.

steps.title: Flooring
steps.intro: Choose the floor type and colour.

options.label: Porcelain tiles
options.prompt: Use the base floor with large light grey porcelain tiles.

options.label: Ceramic tiles
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor to smaller 30 cm square ceramic tiles in light grey with visible grout lines.

options.label: LVT
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor to luxury vinyl planks in a natural light oak wood effect.

options.label: Vinyl
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor to seamless sheet vinyl in a soft grey stone effect.

options.label: Light grey
options.prompt: Use the base floor (light grey).

options.label: Dark grey
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor colour to dark grey.

options.label: Warm oak
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor to a warm oak wood-effect finish.

options.label: Stone beige
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor colour to warm beige stone.

options.label: White marble effect
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor to white marble effect with soft grey veining.

options.label: Black
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the floor colour to matt black.

steps.title: Vanity and furniture
steps.intro: Choose your vanity unit, basin, furniture colour and any extra storage.

options.label: Wall-hung
options.prompt: Use the base vanity with a light oak wall-hung unit.

options.label: Floor-standing
options.desc: Extra storage, sits on the floor
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity to a floor-standing unit with two doors that sits on the floor.

options.label: Double vanity
options.prompt: Keep everything identical but widen the view: a wide wall-hung vanity with two basins and two taps, two round mirrors.

options.label: No vanity
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Remove the vanity and show a white wall-mounted basin with the waste pipe neatly visible below.

options.label: Countertop
options.desc: Sits on top of the unit
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the basin to a round white countertop basin sitting on top of the vanity.

options.label: Inset
options.prompt: Use the base vanity with an inset white basin.

options.label: Integrated
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the basin to a seamless integrated white basin and vanity top in one piece.

options.label: Semi-recessed
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the basin to a semi-recessed white basin that overhangs the front of a slimmer vanity.

options.label: Light oak
options.prompt: Use the base vanity (light oak).

options.label: Walnut
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity to dark walnut wood.

options.label: Matt white
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity colour to matt white.

options.label: Dove grey
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity colour to soft matt dove grey.

options.label: Sage green
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity colour to matt sage green.

options.label: Navy
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity colour to matt navy blue.

options.label: Charcoal
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the vanity colour to matt charcoal.

options.label: Tall unit
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add a slim tall light oak storage cupboard beside the vanity.

options.label: Mirror cabinet
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Replace the round mirror with a rectangular mirrored wall cabinet, one door slightly open showing toiletries.

options.label: Open shelving
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add two floating light oak shelves to the side with rolled towels and a small plant.

options.label: Built-in recess
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add a tiled built-in wall recess with glass shelves beside the toilet.

steps.title: Taps, showers and fittings
steps.intro: Choose the finish for your taps and fittings, your shower and your toilet.

options.label: Chrome
options.prompt: Use the base tap in polished chrome.

options.label: Matt black
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tap finish to matt black.

options.label: Brushed brass
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tap finish to brushed brass.

options.label: Brushed nickel
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tap finish to brushed nickel.

options.label: Gunmetal
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the tap finish to brushed gunmetal grey.

options.label: Rainfall and handset
options.prompt: Close-up of a shower wall with a large square overhead rainfall shower head and a separate handheld shower on a slide rail, thermostatic valve below, light grey tiles, chrome.

options.label: Thermostatic bar
options.prompt: Close-up of a shower wall with an exposed thermostatic bar shower valve, riser rail and handheld shower head, light grey tiles, chrome.

options.label: Electric shower
options.prompt: Close-up of a shower wall with a slim modern white electric shower unit, riser rail and handheld head, light grey tiles.

options.label: Digital shower
options.prompt: Close-up of a shower wall with a sleek digital shower control panel with a small display, overhead rainfall head, light grey tiles, chrome.

options.label: Frameless clear glass
options.prompt: A walk-in shower with a single frameless clear glass panel, light grey tiles, soft daylight.

options.label: Black framed
options.prompt: A walk-in shower with a black-framed grid glass panel in a Crittall style, light grey tiles, soft daylight.

options.label: Fluted glass
options.prompt: A walk-in shower with a reeded fluted glass panel and a slim brushed metal frame, light grey tiles, soft daylight.

options.label: Bath screen
options.desc: For a shower over a bath
options.prompt: A white built-in bath with a fixed clear glass bath screen and an overhead shower, light grey tiles, soft daylight.

options.label: Wall-hung
options.prompt: Close-up of a white wall-hung toilet with a concealed cistern and a chrome flush plate, light grey tiles.

options.label: Back to wall
options.desc: Hidden cistern, sits on the floor
options.prompt: Close-up of a white back-to-wall toilet in front of a light oak unit hiding the cistern, light grey tiles.

options.label: Close coupled
options.prompt: Close-up of a white modern close-coupled toilet with the cistern on top, light grey tiles.

options.label: Comfort height
options.prompt: Close-up of a white comfort-height toilet with a slightly taller pan and a small grab rail beside it, light grey tiles.

steps.title: Mirrors, lighting and finishing touches
steps.intro: Choose your mirror, then any extras you'd like.

options.label: LED mirror
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the mirror to a round LED backlit mirror glowing softly.

options.label: Standard mirror
options.prompt: Use the base vanity with its round mirror.

options.label: Mirror cabinet
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Change only the mirror to a rectangular mirrored wall cabinet.

options.label: Recessed spotlights
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add four small recessed ceiling spotlights, switched on.

options.label: Feature lighting
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add a small glass pendant light beside the mirror, switched on, warm glow.

options.label: LED strip lighting
options.desc: In niches or under the vanity
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add warm LED strip lighting under the vanity and in the shower niche, switched on, slightly dimmer room.

options.label: Heated towel rail
options.prompt: Keep everything identical. Add a chrome ladder-style heated towel rail on the wall with a folded white towel.

options.label: Shower niche
options.prompt: Use the base wall, which shows the shower niche.

options.label: Underfloor heating
options.prompt: A bathroom floor partly laid: electric underfloor heating mat with thin orange heating cables on insulation boards, half covered with light grey porcelain tiles, top-down view.

steps.title: Review your design
steps.intro: Check your choices, add a few details and send your design to us for a free quotation.
